contract.title: STOP Discipline
contract.frozen_contract: Strict stop-condition enforcement: stop and report rather than improvising when a frozen STOP condition is reached; do not continue once the Requirement Ledger proves completion with no material gate remaining.
plan_stop_conditions: project root conflicts with unrelated existing data
global config cannot be safely merged
current Prime hook API differs materially from assumed architecture
adapter would overwrite unrelated skill directories
context pruning could delete unrecoverable data
contract.expected_automated_evidence: Canonical stop lifecycle events, CLI decision matrix, bounded parser/state, OMP tool-call enforcement, worker context identity, and finalization tests.
contract.required_live_runtime_evidence: OMP-primary success, delegated worker, failed/blocker, incomplete negative control, bounded ledger/telemetry evidence, and zero substantive post-STOP execution.
contract.cross_harness_target: Universal Brain CLI/ledger primitive with thin OMP lifecycle adapter; OMP-primary enforcement proven here without changing P3.1-P3.5 or Lean promotion.
contract.token_economic_objective: No trailing substantive tool/model loop after STOP; only bounded result/finalization/yield/session events remain.
contract.dogfood_requirement: Implementation probes themselves reached STOP and stopped before P3.7 or unrelated cleanup.
contract.promotion_acceptance_gates: Automated checks, current OMP-primary runtime cases, canonical evidence, independent Validator reconstruction, prior-phase regression gate, and explicit P3.7 exclusion all pass.

behavior: Existing Requirement Ledger decides stop/continue; unresolved material requirements force continue.
Tool-call is the narrow OMP enforcement boundary; post-STOP substantive tools and their results are blocked per session.
Synchronous stop_finalized ledger append closes the durability race before OMP worker teardown.
Only session_shutdown, telemetry, stop_finalize, and yield remain allowed after STOP.
Worker context marker propagates parent_session_id; current placeholders resolve session and worker identities separately.

classification.cross_harness: PROVEN for the frozen OMP-primary boundary composed with universal Brain primitives
classification.token_economics: PROVEN: live stop boundaries show zero executed substantive post-stop tool events; only bounded result/finalization/provider-final-answer/session events follow
classification.promotion_acceptance: PROVEN after fresh independent Validator reconstruction

canonical_evidence.post_boundary_policy: No substantive tool_requested/tool_completed event is accepted after the boundary; bounded control result, finalization, yield, turn, agent_end, and session shutdown remain permitted.
canonical_evidence.post_boundary_count: Runtime field is sourced from per-session StopBoundaryState; live probes recorded 0 executed substantive events after boundary.

successful_completion.evidence: stop decision passed/satisfied; stop_boundary and stop_finalized; zero substantive post-stop tool execution; only result/turn/shutdown/agent_end follow.

worker_completion.evidence: worker stop boundary, synchronous finalization, bounded yield/result, worker agent_end/session completion, and unaffected parent task result.

failed_or_blocked.evidence: failed verification arms stop; subsequent substantive bash is stop_blocked with no executed tool result.

incomplete_negative_control.evidence: material requirement unresolved yields decision=continue, reason=requirements_unresolved, stop_not_triggered, no stop boundary.

post_stop_block.evidence: deliberate post-STOP bash attempt records stop_blocked and does not execute.
